proof_summary: The proof constructs prime-power coefficients \(a_e\) via \(a_0=1\) and \(e a_e=\sum_{k=1}^e u_k a_{e-k}\), proving \(u_k\ge0\) from explicit odd/even recurrences and the inductive bound \(c_k\ge 2^{k-1}/k\) for \(u_k=kc_k\), hence \(a_e\ge0\). It then shows \(\sum_{j=0}^e a_j a_{e-j}=2^{A005187(e)}\) by matching recurrences using \(A005187(e)=e+A005187(\lfloor e/2\rfloor)\), and extends these coefficients multiplicatively, making every value a product of nonnegative prime-power factors.
